{"sql":"SELECT period, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, SUM(revenue_cad) AS total_revenue
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period","purpose":"Get total units sold and revenue for Aug and Sep 2026"}
